title: Parmesan Crispbreads
description: Crisp, cheesy rounds made from plain flour, salted butter and Parmesan. Like posh Mini Cheddars — serve with dips, cheese or pâté.
steps: Sift the flour into a bowl and add the cubes of butter. Rub together until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add the grated Parmesan (holding back 1 tablespoon for topping) and bring together into a dough. Cover with cling film and chill for an hour.
Roll the chilled dough to 1cm thick and cut into rounds with a 5cm fluted cutter. Place on a lined baking tray, a few centimetres apart. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan.
Bake for 15 minutes until crisp and golden. Cool on a wire rack.
